title: First Glimpse of Heavenly Secrets
next_chapter_hook: "At the moment the Tianji Record first activated, Chen Ji felt an utterly supreme consciousness slowly gazing at him from the depths of the Void. The oppressive might of that consciousness made his very soul tremble—it was the Eye of Heavenly Dao, turning its gaze for the first time upon this ant who considered himself a chess master."

text.content: "Night hung like ink, and the cold wind of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain carried the scent of decaying leaves. Chen Ji stood alone at the Cliff Edge, the turtle shell that had accompanied him for seven years clutched tightly in his hand. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's words still echoed in his ears, each word searing his heart like a branding iron—Chen Nian was beneath the Tianqing Sect, within the Ancient Forbidden Land. Seven years. He had believed his sister long dead, never imagining she lay in the deepest depths beneath his very feet, imprisoned for a full seven years."

dialogue.content: "『Ji'er, the old man knows your heart overflows with questions. But your cultivation is too shallow now—the more you know, the faster you die.』 Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul quivered faintly within the turtle shell, his voice carrying a gravity Chen Ji had never before heard, 『That forbidden place—even this old man's peak strength back then did not dare tread lightly. Your sister... surviving until now is already a miracle.』"

text.content: "Chen Ji spoke no words. His fingers dug deep into the turtle shell's patterns, seeping blood staining those ancient, mysterious runes. For seven years, he had lived as worthless trash at the very bottom of the Tianqing Sect, enduring countless cold stares and humiliations, all for the sake of waiting for one chance—a chance to find his sister. Now the chance lay before him, yet the price demanded he attack a stone with an egg."

"『Waste! Halt!』 A thunderous roar shattered Chen Ji's thoughts. Not far away, three disciples in Inner Sect robes approached, their leader Zhao Tie—a follower of Han Lie, the foremost genius of the Xuanwu Sect. He carried a wine jug, reeking of alcohol, his gaze toward Chen Ji brimming with contempt, 『Hiding in the back mountain playing ghost at this hour? What, thinking of jumping off the cliff to end it all?』"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji raised his head, a flash of ice-cold light flickering in his eyes, but quickly restored that cowardly appearance. 『Z-Zhao... Senior Brother, I only came to... to gather herbs. I wouldn't dare disturb Senior Brothers.』 His voice trembled slightly, portraying cowardice to perfection. Seven years of disguise had carved itself into his very marrow, allowing him to instantly switch to that humble mask under any circumstance."

text.content: "Zhao Tie and his companions exchanged glances, bursting into laughter in unison. 『Gathering herbs? As if trash like you deserves to?』 Zhao Tie kicked Chen Ji square in the chest, the tremendous force sending him flying backward to crash heavily against an ancient pine at the cliff's edge. Chen Ji spat a mouthful of blood, and the turtle shell in his hand cracked open a fine line from the violent impact. A power Chen Ji had never before felt surged from the crack."

dialogue.content: "『Get lost, waste. Remember to scrub the night chamber pots in the elixir room tomorrow!』 Zhao Tie spat, and the three swaggered away. Chen Ji curled on the ground, his body convulsing violently—not from pain, but because that power gushing from the turtle shell crack was frantically scouring his meridians. He felt it—a stream of information beyond mortal comprehension, undergoing some bizarre fusion with his divine soul."

text.content: "『It is done.』 Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, carrying an uncontrollable excitement, 『The turtle shell has finally fully awakened. The Tianji Record Fragment is about to reveal its true form. Ji'er, are you prepared? This power... is far heavier than you can imagine.』 Before the words even finished, the cracks on the turtle shell suddenly widened, and blinding golden light erupted from the fractures, illuminating the entire cliff as bright as day."

"Chen Ji felt his consciousness drawn into a chaotic void. Countless golden runes flowed like a galaxy before his eyes, each rune containing information beyond words. His divine soul was torn apart then重组, pain driving him nearly insane. But from the abyss of that agony, a voice emerged—the voice of the Tianji Record itself, ancient, majestic, utterly devoid of emotion:"

dialogue.content: "『Tianji Record·Fragment·First Page, Unsealed.』 The voice rang like a heavenly verdict, permitting no refusal, 『Holder Chen Ji, gains three-hour Foresight Ability. Each glimpse of Heavenly Secrets shall consume five points of Heavenly Fate and endure the backlash of Blood Pulse shackles. The day Heavenly Fate reaches zero is the moment of soul annihilation.』"

text.content: "The golden light gradually faded, and Chen Ji returned to the cliff. But the turtle shell was gone from his hand, replaced by a thin-as-cicada-wing golden fragment. The runes on the fragment still glowed faintly, as if alive within it. He could clearly sense that a flesh-and-blood connection had formed between himself and this fragment—it had become part of his body."

choice.prompt: "The Tianji Record Fragment now in hand, Chen Ji felt unprecedented power surging within him. He needed to verify the authenticity of this power."

choices.description: "Boldly attempt the first Foresight Ability, to see what will happen in three hours"
choices.visible_cost: "Consume 5 Heavenly Fate points, may face unknown backlash"
choices.visible_reward: "Gained the ability to foresee three hours into the future"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, pouring his will into the golden fragment. The fragment instantly burst into brilliant radiance, and an incomparably profound power surged from his Brow Center into the depths of his divine soul. His vision went black, consciousness drawn into a hazy mist. Gradually, the mist cleared, and a scene vividly emerged—three hours later, at this very cliff, his sister Chen Nian's figure flashed past, then vanished into the depths of the earth."

"『This is...』 Chen Ji's heart hammered wildly. Though the vision was brief and blurry, that was Chen Nian! His sister, missing for seven years! Her face had grown gaunt beyond memory, her eyes filled with despair and exhaustion. But just as Chen Ji wanted to see more clearly, the vision shattered violently. A searing agony exploded from the depths of his divine soul. He felt his Blood Pulse power being drained away as if by something, his entire body instantly weakened by a third."

choices.description: "Temporarily refrain from activating the Tianji Record, conceal this power, observe secretly"
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain disguise, do not expose trump card"

text.content: "Chen Ji clenched his teeth, forcibly suppressing the urge to activate the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng was right—the waste persona he had cultivated for seven years in the Tianqing Sect must not be destroyed by a moment of impulse. He tucked the golden fragment into his chest, covering its faint glow with his clothing. For seven years he had schemed in the shadows, and this time would be no exception."

"『Good.』 Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of praise, 『Your ability to restrain your craving for power at this age shows you're more mature than this master imagined. But Ji'er, remember—the stronger the Tianji Record's power grows, the heavier the price. Each use is draining your life force.』"

"Chen Ji gazed at his trembling hands. Though that brief foresight had left him in agony, it also revealed one truth—the Tianji Record's power was real. He truly could foresee the future. Yet simultaneously, that drained Blood Pulse power had left his body abnormally weak. The price of this power was far heavier than he had imagined."

"Just then, an indescribable chill suddenly rose along his spine. Chen Ji jerked his head up, staring toward the deepest darkness of the night sky. He felt it—something was watching him—an existence beyond mortal perception, its gaze pressing upon his divine soul like tangible matter, making his soul tremble. It was... the Eye of Heavenly Dao!"

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned urgent and tense: 『Ji'er, do not actively sense it! That is the Eye of Heavenly Dao, sovereign of all seers. You're far too weak now—once it notices you...』 Before he could finish, the pressure of that gaze vanished without a trace, as if it had never existed. But Chen Ji knew it was no illusion. The Eye of Heavenly Dao had truly noticed him at that moment, just as one might notice a new piece appearing on a chessboard."

choice.prompt: "The brief gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Dao made Chen Ji realize that this power he had gained was far more than a mere blessing. Now he needed to decide how to respond to this terrifying discovery."

choices.text: "Question Mo Xiansheng about the truth of the Eye of Heavenly Dao"
choices.description: "Disregard Mo Xiansheng's warnings, insist on questioning everything about the Eye of Heavenly Dao"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain key information about the Eye of Heavenly Dao"

dialogue.content: "『Teacher, what exactly is the Eye of Heavenly Dao?』 Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet his tone carried unyielding resolve, 『You've always told me to hide, to endure, but I don't even know who my enemy is. How can I scheme?』 Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long while before finally sighing: 『Ji'er, some truths, known too early become death warrants. But since you ask... the Eye of Heavenly Dao is the incarnation of Heavenly Dao's will. It views all seers throughout history as chess pieces. The Tianji Record is merely one of its pieces spread across the mortal realm.』"

choices.description: "Ask nothing for now, continue pretending as planned, bide time for opportunity"
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain good relationship with Mo Xiansheng, receive more guidance"
choices.risk_hint: "May suffer吃亏 from ignorance at critical moments"

text.content: "Chen Ji suppressed the urge to question further. He knew Mo Xiansheng spoke truth—some knowledge becomes burden rather than asset. He gently stroked the Tianji Record Fragment hidden in his chest, burying the urge to question the Eye of Heavenly Dao deep within. What mattered most now was growing stronger. Only strength earned the right to truth."

dialogue.content: "『Good.』 A note of relief appeared in Mo Xiansheng's voice, 『You're far steadier than this master was at your age. Had this master possessed half your restraint back then, I would not have ended up this way either. Ji'er, remember—the Tianji Record's power is for scheming, not for showing off. As long as you live, there will always be a chance to turn the tables.』"

text.content: "Night wind swept across the cliff, Chen Ji's robes fluttering wildly. He stood in place, his gaze deep and profound as he stared toward the distant horizon. The Ancient Forbidden Land beneath Tianqing Sect, his sister missing seven years, the awakened Tianji Record, and that terrifying Eye of Heavenly Dao... all the clues whirled ceaselessly in his mind, weaving into a vast and intricate web."

"『Zhao Tie...』 Chen Ji murmured that name, a meaningful curve lifting the corner of his lips. The humiliation just now was already recorded in his ledger—but not now. What he needed now was to continue playing the role of one trampled by all, letting everyone believe he remained the ant they could crush at will. Until... the day he had the power to repay every humiliation a hundredfold, a thousandfold."

choice.prompt: "The Tianji Record had awakened. Chen Ji needed to decide his next move. Continue enduring in concealment, or begin scheming secretly?"

choices.description: "Use the newly gained Tianji Record ability to find a way into the Ancient Forbidden Land"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain key intelligence about the Forbidden Land"
choices.risk_hint: "Forbidden Land guards are strict; rash action may alarm the enemy"

text.content: "Chen Ji began sorting through all information about the Ancient Forbidden Land in his mind. As the lowest-ranking Servant Disciple of the Tianqing Sect, he had traversed nearly every corner of the sect over seven years. Those heavily guarded areas, those forbidden zones... he had silently committed them all to memory. Now was the time to put this knowledge to use. He would find the entrance to the Forbidden Land, no matter the cost."

choices.description: "For now remain still, use the Tianji Record's ability to assist cultivation, enhance Strength"
choices.visible_reward: "Increased Strength, laying foundation for subsequent actions"

text.content: "Chen Ji knew deeply that with his current Strength, finding the Forbidden Land entrance would only mean death. He had to grow stronger—and quickly. Though the Tianji Record's Foresight Ability carried a price, if applied to cultivation, it could let him avoid risks in advance, dramatically improving cultivation efficiency. He would leverage every foresight to multiply his cultivation speed several times over ordinary disciples."

choices.description: "Use the waste identity as cover, secretly observe the movements of the three major sects and the Demonic Path"

text.content: "Chen Ji turned toward the elixir room. In his mind, he was already calculating the chess game ahead. Undercurrents churned within the Tianqing Sect, the Xuanwu Sect watched covetously, the Demonic Holy Sect stirred restlessly... he needed more intelligence to move without regret in this chaotic game. And his greatest advantage was that everyone regarded him as nothing more than insignificant waste."

"Just as Chen Ji turned to leave the cliff, a cold, eerie voice suddenly rang beside his ear—『Waste, that aura about you... quite interesting.』 Chen Ji's heart sank violently. He slowly turned his head, seeing a white-clothed figure had appeared on a nearby tree at some unknown moment. Beneath the moonlight, the figure wore a black gown, features stunning yet carrying an oddly sinister beauty. It was the Holy Sect's Saint—Ye Qing of the Demonic Path."
